title: Hamming (hard decision, separate demodulation and decoding) vs Euclidean (soft, joint demodulation and decoding) in a known tract

hypotheses.H1_primary: In every primary cell the Euclidean arm requires less Eb/N0 than the Hamming arm at the cell's primary target BER (gain > 0 dB, 95% CI lower bound > 0).
hypotheses.H2_secondary_csi_weight: In ITU moderate fading the CSI-weighted Euclidean metric needs no more Eb/N0 than the unweighted one (descriptive, identical observations).
hypotheses.H3_secondary_practical: With causal pilot estimation the Euclidean arm keeps a positive gain over Hamming (descriptive).

design.energy_sweep: amplitude at fixed noise variance; axis Eb/N0 = gamma_b,d validated in docs/research/EBN0_VALIDATION_UK.md (pilot energy included in Eb)
design.common_random_numbers: same information bits, fading and noise per trial index at every Eb/N0 point; only the amplitude changes
design.pairing: both arms decode the same observation and the same frontend output in every trial
design.stopping_rule: fixed design (no data-dependent stopping); a cell stopped by its time budget is reported as incomplete and may be resumed with identical configuration

decisions: 0.5 dB grid steps where the Euclidean AWGN/static curve falls steeply
400 frames/point for AWGN and static so BER 1e-3 carries >=100 Euclidean errors
1000 frames/point for fading cells because each 512-element frame spans about one fade at 0.5-1 Hz Doppler

array_storage.policy: raw signal arrays (TX/RX/frontend/branch metrics) for trial indices divisible by 100 at every point; all other trials keep reference and decoded pairs plus payload mask, sufficient for the independent error recount
array_storage.reason: about 125 KB per full trial; 119 200 trials would need about 15 GB

cells.note: same root seed as A3: identical observations, Hamming arm identical; isolates the CSI weight
same root seed as A3: identical transmitted frame and channel; causal pilot estimate instead of the known tract

analysis.gain_definition: Eb/N0 required by Hamming minus Eb/N0 required by Euclidean at the target BER, dB
analysis.interpolation: linear in log10(BER) between adjacent measured points; no extrapolation
analysis.bootstrap: paired trial-cluster percentile bootstrap with common clusters across Eb/N0 points
analysis.claims_policy: paper_exact=false; the article's 1.5 dB is compared descriptively only; no result is tuned to it

known_limitations: ITU-R F.1487 differential delays (0.5-2 ms) are not reproduced; the second path uses 3 samples because the clean-tail combiner requires delays below 8 samples
known tract = exact channel coefficients (genie CSI); S2 shows the practical pilot-estimated tract
Eb/N0 is validated for the discrete AWGN model; band filters, synchronisation and the radio's pulse shape are not modelled
encoder labeling and generator are project reconstructions (SCI-02)
